notes: The eventmodeling diagram (a Langium-based grammar) parses and draws entity/data/note declarations, but only the entities referenced by a timeframe (tf) actually render as visible text on the canvas: EVENTITY02 and EVCMD04 (used in `tf` lines) extract from the PDF, while the data entity EVDATA05, its value EVDATAVAL06, and the note EVNOTE07 do not appear in the extracted PDF text at all (not just as non-extractable paths -- they are not drawn). Kept in document.md to exercise parsing of those statements, but excluded from markers.
